overview:
NY-13 is a heavily Democratic Upper Manhattan seat, and Adriano Espaillat is not on the ballot after losing renomination. Darializa Avila Chevalier carries the Democratic banner and enters the general election with strong financial backing, having raised about $1.35 million and drawn significant outside spending on her behalf. Republican Jomo Williams reports no fundraising activity.

The district's +32 Democratic partisan lean makes a general-election contest essentially a formality, and prediction markets price a Democratic win at roughly 97 percent. With no public polling available, the forecast rests on fundamentals, which point to a comfortable Democratic hold in the mid-to-high twenty-point range.
